decisions.reason: Spout removability or flushability does not change the separate requirement that the bottom bowl seal prevent seepage into the electronics.
The spout-cleaning requirement does not modify the existing requirement to prevent liquid from leaking into the base.
Cleaning by removal or flushing does not alter the controlled-stream, dripping, or flow-rate requirements; those are addressed by separate clauses in the source message.
The cleaning clause does not change the selected simple open/close valve or tap actuation mechanism.
Requiring the spout to be removable or easy to flush does not necessarily change its barista-facing orientation.
The spout-cleaning decision does not change the base support or operational-stability requirements.
The source does not entail any change to enclosure thickness, size, or proportions.
The spout-cleaning requirement does not modify bowl depth, capacity, or geometry.
The source decision has no effect on the machine's branded title text.
The cleaning method does not necessarily modify the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The source decision does not change the green accent color or any finish requirement.
Spout removability or flushability does not change the independent requirement to minimize splashing during mixing.
